newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senator backs Pa. sales tax hike proposal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senator backs Pa. sales tax hike proposal.

text.p: U.S. Sen. Rick Santorum said he supports a proposal to raise the regional sales tax for 10 western Pennsylvania counties by a half percentage point.
The move, which would affect Allegheny County and nine surrounding counties, must be approved by voters in a November referendum.

The revenues would be used for economic development projects and to build a new professional baseball stadium for the Pittsburgh Pirates. But critics say the benefits are weighed to much in favor of Pittsburgh.
Santorum said the money generated from the tax increase would be more than paid back by future economic development and growth.
